summary: OpenSpec publishes no accuracy, token or agent-outcome results, and the repository has no benchmark or eval directory. Its quantitative self-measurements are CLI module-load counts in CHANGELOG entries: `openspec status --json` loads 163 modules instead of 186, `openspec __complete` 48 instead of 344, and `openspec --version` and `--help` 24 instead of 485. test/cli-e2e/startup-modules.test.ts records loaded modules through a Node hook and asserts which modules load, not how many, so the published counts are not reproduced by a documented command.
result_focus_note: manual classification of published_results: outcome = does the tool do its job; engineering = speed of the software itself
